name: Get banner details
description: Call this when the Automation UI needs to display the status banner (e.g., marketing email status, profile completeness, or account warnings). Use a more specific account‑status endpoint if you only need the marketing email status without the full banner payload.
preconditions: The user must be authenticated and have access to the Automation feature.

marketing_email_status.description: Whether marketing emails are enabled for the account.

is_profile_complete.description: 1 if the account profile is complete, 0 otherwise.

err_msg.description: Message key describing any account‑level warning shown on the banner.
